traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements for docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md are fully implemented and verified.
Core functionality and syntax/format validation (REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION, REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION, REQ-PATH-FORMAT, REQ-REQ-FORMAT) are implemented in src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts and comprehensively tested in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts, which covers both valid examples and all the invalid patterns called out in the story (missing extension, path traversal, missing identifiers, malformed IDs, etc.). Multi-line handling and flexible parsing behavior (REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT, REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING) are validated both in unit tests and in the large-file performance test. Error messages are specific, echo offending values, and include concrete examples, matching REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY and the User Experience and Error Handling acceptance criteria. Documentation describes the expected formats and examples of valid/invalid annotations, satisfying the Documentation criterion. All related tests pass in the latest npm test run. Therefore this story is assessed as PASSED.
